text: The evaluation pipeline begins when the automated dialogue agent's response is received as input.
The response data is routed simultaneously across four parallel feature extraction modules.
The next sentence prediction attribute evaluates response relevance using bidirectional text conditioning.
The repetition module analyzes phrase overlap across the dialogue.
It explicitly computes unigram, bigram, and trigram redundancy across internal, external, and partner utterances.
The question asking attribute measures conversational balance by calculating the number of questions asked.
The short safe answers detection attribute evaluates utterance length and the presence of named entities.
Numeric scores generated by all four parallel components converge toward the decision layer.
The classifier combines these extracted feature values to assess overall dialogue fluidity.
Finally, the system outputs the final response classification.
